summary: Raj Shamani is a high-profile Indian media entrepreneur, bestselling author, and investor who founded Figuring Out Media. With over 11.6 million Instagram followers, he operates at the intersection of personal development, business strategy, and media production. His public persona is built on interviewing 'extraordinary people' to decode their thinking, while simultaneously promoting his own ventures, including the investment firm CÜRAA and his media empire. He presents himself as a self-made figure from a non-elite background who leverages curiosity and strategic questioning to drive growth.
